name: Grok 4.7
archDisplay: Proprietary sparse-MoE reasoning model (undisclosed size); 500K-token context
note: SpaceXAI's September 16, 2026 point release — Grok 4.6's successor at an unchanged $2/$6 per Mtok. The launch table is a straight line over 4.6's: GDPval-AA +43, AA Briefcase +44, DeepSWE +3.5, CursorBench +3.9, Terminal-Bench 3 +3.7, with a first-time ExploitBench row (44.8) replacing the marketing-speak with a defensive-security number. No major capability claims beyond 'fastest frontier agent on our harness'; the honest read is a steady monthly cadence keeping Grok roughly level with Sonnet-class mid-frontier models rather than contesting Astra/Fable at the top.
